composition.serve_who: This sheet (108-01-515-001 "RAW WATER SYSTEM SCHEMATIC") is the raw-water cooling system distribution diagram. It serves multiple engine-room and machinery cooling consumers fed from a single Sea Chest (001-01) with two strainer/branch legs: PORT generator cooling loop, STBD generator cooling loop, main system heat exchangers (port/stbd) for the propulsion/hydraulics cooling circuit, hydraulic pumps heat exchanger, pitch control (CPP) heat exchanger, aircon seawater supply, and watermaker seawater supply. The seachest itself is also fitted with a Cathelco galvanic (cathodic) protection control unit. Two internal heat exchangers (80L FWD/AFT boilers) are shown at sheet edges fed by gy16 lines (glycol/coolant, out of scope for raw water) — these are calorifier heat exchangers off the generator coolant circuit, not raw-water consumers directly walked here beyond the label. The lower-left general-arrangement inset (ESS racks, BEL inverters, MAPS/EDN/MPCS, W/MAKER units) is a DIFFERENT drawing region (equipment layout plan) reusing similar labels but is NOT part of the raw-water schematic's own walked piping — those items belong to their own electrical/BAE system nodes, not this raw-water system node, and are discarded here as clutter/out-of-scope for this composition pass since no raw-water pipe connects them on this sheet.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Seachest 001-01 box is the titled system boundary on the sheet, matches register node 515-seachest-main exactly.

functions.label: Raw seawater intake and distribution to two strainer branches
functions.what_it_does: Draws seawater through two below-DWL thru-hull inlets, each with its own 3" NC valve and seawater strainer, feeding a main branch manifold that supplies both the main cooling pump suction lines and a flush connection point for reverse-flushing.

flow_scenarios.path: seawater inlet (below DWL, 3" valve, NO) -> seawater strainer -> main branch manifold -> 2" valve (NO) branch -> th51 line -> MCSWP-P / MCSWP-S suction
flush connection point / 1" valve -> main branch manifold -> reverse flow through strainer/inlet to clear fouling
second below-DWL inlet (3" valve, NO) -> second seawater strainer -> 2" valve branches -> th51 supply to CPSWP / pitch control loop

functions.dry_data: Seachest 001-01, SWS CUSTOM per BOM item 001; thru-hull details per DWG 108-01-504-002.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Named box '009-01 CATHELCO GALVANIC PROTECTION CONTROL UNIT' sits inside seachest region; BOM item 009 confirms make Cathelco Ltd, SWS code CATH-NANOSYS, model 'SEA CHEST NANO 3 SYSTEM'. This is cathodic protection, matching the galvanic-control node rather than the raw-water pump node.

flow_scenarios.path: seachest th51 supply -> valve 007-07 (NO) -> MCSWP-P (013-01) -> valve 007-08 (NO) -> th51 line -> NC solenoid 018-02 (SCU) -> to main system heat exchanger - port (010-01) raw water side -> overboard via th40 seawater outlet below DWL
priming line from fresh water supply (ref DWG 108-01-510-01) feeds pump casing prior to start
flow switch FS (016-01) on th40 line senses loss of flow through HX 010-01 and reports to SCU

facts: Sheet is the master raw-water schematic; individual sub-loops (generators, main HX, hydraulic HX, CPP HX, watermaker, aircon) all branch from the single seachest (001-01) shown right-of-center.
Pipe legend distinguishes seawater metallic pipe, seawater flex pipe, coolant metallic/flex pipe, hydraulic oil flex pipe, vent/breather flex pipe, fresh water (cold) — colors keyed on drawing.

Pipe details table gives ID/OD/rating/material/max pressure/weight per pipe code (th25/th30/th35/th40/th45/th51 = Iberica de Mangueras Thor Easyflex fire-resistant hoses rated 7 bar; mw19-51 = Vetus Maxwell marine water hoses rated 2.5 bar; sea42/sea54 = W&O CuNiFe pipe).
All seawater outlets/inlets below DWL are 1.5" unless noted (2"/3" at seachest legs).

Note 1: thru-hull valves detailed separately in DWG 108-01-504-002. Note 2: read in conjunction with Cooling Water System Schematic DWG 108-01-515-002. Note 3: quick-couplers on main heat exchangers allow flushing of seawater circuit to remove fouling.
Breathers throughout (anti-siphon manifolds, NC solenoid vents) all run into the E-R vent box ref DWG 108-01-508-001 (not a raw-water flow path, a vent path).

uncertainties: Two 80L boiler heat exchangers (FWD/AFT) at far right/left sheet edges are fed by gy16-coded lines (per pipe legend, gy16 is not explicitly defined in the pipe details table shown — likely a glycol/coolant loop code) rather than raw seawater; their exact commodity and connection to the raw water system is not clearly walkable from this sheet and is left unassigned to a raw-water function.

The lower-left general-arrangement inset (SEACHEST/pump/ACTM/BEL-P1-P2/BEL-S1-S2/W-MAKER1/W-MAKER2/EDN-S/MAPS-S/MPCS-S/ESS1-3/tank-loop-top) appears to be a different sheet region (equipment layout / electrical arrangement) with topology extraction connections that do not correspond to drawn raw-water piping on this schematic; treated as out-of-scope/clutter for this raw-water composition rather than forcing false flow scenarios.
